blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit and Related Summits opened in Manila on Sunday, with President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos Jr. formally declaring the three-day gathering underway. Speaking at the opening ceremony at the Philippine International Convention Center, Marcos, the 2026 Asean chair, called for regional unity and shared responsibility, describing Asean as “different nations moving with common purpose, each sharing responsibility, unified in action, for the strength of the whole.” LIVE UPDATES: Asean Summit 2026 and related meetings, Nov. 15, 2026 The summit, which runs from Nov. 15 to 17, brings together leaders from Asean […]...
